hebrewText: הָמ֣וּ ג֭וֹיִם מָ֣טוּ מַמְלָכ֑וֹת נָתַ֥ן בְּ֝/קוֹל֗/וֹ תָּמ֥וּג אָֽרֶץ

tokens.bdb: to make a loud sound (like English 'hum'); by implication, to be in great commotion or tumult, to rage, war, moan, clamor
tokens.kjv: clamorous, concourse, cry aloud, be disquieted, loud, mourn, be moved, make a noise, rage, roar, sound, be troubled, make in tumult, tumultuous, be in an uproar.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: to make a loud sound ; by implication
tokens.enLiteralWord: to make a loud sound ; by implication
tokens.explanation: to make a loud sound ; by implication
tokens.explanationEn: to make a loud sound ; by implication

tokens.bdb: a foreign nation; hence, a Gentile; also (figuratively) a troop of animals, or a flight of locusts
to waver; by implication, to slip, shake, fall
tokens.kjv: be carried, cast, be out of course, be fallen in decay, [idiom] exceedingly, fall(-ing down), be (re-) moved, be ready, shake, slide, slip.

tokens.bdb: dominion, i.e. (abstractly) the estate (rule) or (concretely) the country (realm)
to give, used with greatest latitude of application (put, make, etc.)
tokens.kjv: add, apply, appoint, ascribe, assign, [idiom] avenge, [idiom] be (healed), bestow, bring (forth, hither), cast, cause, charge, come, commit, consider, count, [phrase] cry, deliver (up), direct, distribute, do, [idiom] doubtless, [idiom] without fail, fasten, frame, [idiom] get, give (forth, over, up), grant, hang (up), [idiom] have, [idiom] indeed, lay (unto charge, up), (give) leave, lend, let (out), [phrase] lie, lift up, make, [phrase] O that, occupy, offer, ordain, pay, perform, place, pour, print, [idiom] pull, put (forth), recompense, render, requite, restore, send (out), set (forth), shew, shoot forth (up), [phrase] sing, [phrase] slander, strike, (sub-) mit, suffer, [idiom] surely, [idiom] take, thrust, trade, turn, utter, [phrase] weep, [phrase] willingly, [phrase] withdraw, [phrase] would (to) God, yield.
tokens.explanation: natan — dar, entregar, conceder, pôr, colocar

tokens.kjv: [phrase] aloud, bleating, crackling, cry ([phrase] out), fame, lightness, lowing, noise, [phrase] hold peace, (pro-) claim, proclamation, [phrase] sing, sound, [phrase] spark, thunder(-ing), voice, [phrase] yell.

tokens.bdb: to melt, i.e. literally (to soften, flow down, disappear), or figuratively (to fear, faint)
tokens.kjv: consume, dissolve, (be) faint(-hearted), melt (away), make soft.

tokens.bdb: the earth (at large, or partitively a land)
tokens.kjv: [idiom] common, country, earth, field, ground, land, [idiom] natins, way, [phrase] wilderness, world.
tokens.explanation: eretz — terra, solo, país, região, toda a terra
